en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalk. On the right corner stands a prominent decorated building with niches, a statue, and ornamental details; signage on its ground floor indicates a beer establishment. Large leafy trees and a simple wooden fence are visible to the right, giving the impression of a small park or garden beside the street.
